description: An independent topological argument: with attention as a thresholded continuous activity on a finite-dimensional manifold, no formal attention schema can represent every moving stream of attention one to one, by invariance of domain. Streams that only jump between frozen states can be represented.
limitations: A highly abstract model. The result fails if the space may have arbitrarily high dimension or grow over time, and it shows incompleteness, not that the schema yields consciousness.
